en.title: dabrafenib: 5.3 and Table 5 give different instructions for one patient
en.summary: 5.3 reads “Permanently discontinue TAFINLAR for all Grade 4 hemorrhagic events”. Table 5 reads “First occurrence of any Grade 4”. Example: At a first Grade 4 hemorrhage, Table 5 allows resuming at a lower dose and 5.3 requires permanent discontinuation. The text is in this label.
en.impact: Potential effect on a prescribing decision: high. Arxo does not say which instruction is correct and gives no dose.
